title: Aromatic Dense Portuguese Mung Bean Sprouts Fritters
description: A citrusy and dense Portuguese dish featuring mung bean sprouts, perfect for festive occasions, this satvik friendly recipe is a delight to make and eat. It is a traditional Portuguese recipe with a twist of Asian flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the mung bean sprouts, onion, garlic, lemon zest, and portuguese spice blend.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chickpea flour and salt.
Add the chickpea flour mixture to the mung bean sprouts mixture and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Coat each patty with additional chickpea flour if needed.
Fry the patties in the hot oil for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
